definitions.full: H1725. dahar [ דָּהַר ] verb rush, dash , of horse (onomatopoetic? perhaps compare Arabic befall, fall upon, overcome, conquer ) — Qal Participle דֹּהֵר סוּס Nahum 3:2 .
